item.title: Karashi Renkon: Mustard Lotus Root — Guide
item.description: Karashi renkon (mustard lotus root) is one of Kumamoto’s most distinctive local specialities, a savoury treat with a history stretching back to the feudal era. Holes of a fresh lotus-root section are packed full of a paste of spicy Japanese mustard (karashi) blended with miso, then the whole root is coated in a turmeric-tinted batter and deep-fried. Sliced into rounds, it reveals the pretty lattice pattern of the lotus, the crunchy root contrasting with the warm, nose-tingling kick of the mustard-miso filling.
